name: Java CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

    branches: [main]

    inputs:
      distribution:
        description: JDK distribution to install
        type: choice
        options:

          - corretto
          - zulu
          - liberica
          - semeru
          - oracle
        default: temurin
      java-version:
        description: JDK version to install
        type: string
        default: "21"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build (${{ github.event.inputs.distribution || vars.JDK_DISTRIBUTION || 'temurin' }} ${{ github.event.inputs.java-version || vars.JDK_VERSION || '21' }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      JDK_DISTRIBUTION: ${{ github.event.inputs.distribution || vars.JDK_DISTRIBUTION || 'temurin' }}
      JDK_VERSION: ${{ github.event.inputs.java-version || vars.JDK_VERSION || '21' }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out sources
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: ${{ env.JDK_DISTRIBUTION }}
          java-version: ${{ env.JDK_VERSION }}
          check-latest: true
          verify-signature: true
          cache: maven

      - name: Verify toolchain
        run: |
          java -version
          mvn --version

      - name: Build
        run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify
